collection.title: MG Express 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MG Express 2003 to 2005 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
